rulings.ruling: ADR-0001 -- Situational Awareness as the primary sink ("spending buys sight")
rulings.summary: SA is the flagship sink for the source-rich/sink-poor economy -- spending money/reputation buys visibility into doom sources.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED, as amended by ADR-0004 (channels/provenance, lead-time semantics, decision-flip acceptance test, simulate-everything/gate-the-view)

rulings.ruling: ADR-0002 -- Scoring: turns survived, lexicographic doom-integral tiebreak, flows only
rulings.summary: Replaces the three-copy ad hoc score formula with turns-survived as primary, a doom-integral tiebreak, and no money/hoarding term.

rulings.ruling: ADR-0003 -- The Liability Ledger (two-sided): every mitigation is a loan
rulings.summary: Every doom mitigation is modeled as a loan with a repayment/consequence chain, not a free action -- the flagship new system.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED as design; build first among the new systems

rulings.ruling: ADR-0004 -- SA amended: channels with provenance, lead-time semantics, decision-flip test
rulings.summary: Refines SA into provenance-tagged channels with lead time, gated by a decision-flip acceptance test rather than a raw admin/god-mode view.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED -- this amends and accepts ADR-0001; build second, after ADR-0003

rulings.ruling: ADR-0005 -- Emergent doom waves: author causes, never outcomes; seed = RNG + schedule
rulings.summary: Doom waves emerge from opponent behavior and the player's ledger (not authored timings); designers author causes, seeded by RNG + schedule.

rulings.ruling: ADR-0006 -- The replay string is the canonical run artifact; backend wiring order
rulings.summary: The seeded-RNG + hash-chain replay backend (already ~80% built) is confirmed as the canonical run artifact, with a wiring order for the rest.

rulings.ruling: ADR-0007 -- Alliances: the third client of Ledger + SA (treaty = shared liability + shared sight)
rulings.summary: Alliances are un-deferred and built as a third client of the Ledger and SA systems -- a treaty shares liability and sight between parties.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED as design; build **third**, strictly after ADR-0003 and ADR-0004

rulings.ruling: ADR-0008 -- Deferrals, folds, and rejections (the negative space of workshop #1)
rulings.summary: Records what workshop #1 explicitly deferred, folded into other ADRs, or rejected, each with its revisit trigger, so decisions aren't silently lost.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED -- negative decisions recorded so they survive

rulings.ruling: ADR-0009 -- Turn structure: plan-months, two decision speeds, day as resolution tick
rulings.summary: Formalizes the drift from week-based planning to day-tick resolution: a MONTH is the decision-cadence layer over day-grain sim ticks.

rulings.ruling: ADR-0010 -- Adoption routing (soft-with-teeth): doom bends where work is adopted
rulings.summary: Safety work no longer bends doom directly/privately; it must be adopted (routed through conferences/papers/orgs) to have effect, killing the safety-spam dominant strategy.

rulings.ruling: ADR-0011 -- The effort economy: founder hours, staff lanes, manager compression
rulings.summary: Replaces the single fungible AP pool with founder Attention + separate per-staff action lanes, compressed by managers.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED (shape); researcher archetype roster content owed (DQ-15)

rulings.ruling: ADR-0012 -- Event response taxonomy: un-snoozable, deferrable, expiring
rulings.summary: Gives DEFER a real taxonomy (un-snoozable / deferrable / expiring) so it isn't a universal free-snooze button that kills the reserve-vs-greed tension.

rulings.ruling: ADR-0013 -- Financing instruments & the cost-of-debt engine
rulings.summary: Replaces flat 25%/turn loan placeholders with one shared pricing engine covering both loans and DEFER carrying-costs.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED (shape; numbers owed to the sweep)

rulings.ruling: ADR-0014 -- Conferences, presence, and minimal location
rulings.summary: Defines what "attending a conference" is (v1: minimal presence/location mechanic, not a full subgame) as the adoption chain's socialization step.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED (v1 shape; yields/numbers owed to the sweep)

rulings.ruling: ADR-0015 -- No printed doom deltas: doom is computed from world state
rulings.summary: Retires hardcoded doom bumps on event/action definitions; doom becomes a computed function of named world-state intermediary streams (see doom_system.gd).

rulings.ruling: ADR-0016 -- League metabolism: the game trails reality by one month
rulings.summary: Moves scouting/meta variance out of the RNG seed and into time: the game runs a month behind real time so real-world events and balance patches can feed in.
rulings.status: ACCEPTED (shape; pipeline build + league-notes format owed)

rulings.ruling: ADR-0017 -- Anti-hollow test strategy (load-time smoke + property-based invariants)
rulings.summary: Targets "hollow" tests that pass without exercising what they protect (zero-test CI, UI-parse-error-with-436-passing); adds load-time smoke and property-based invariants so a green suite means the code actually ran.

rulings.ruling: ADR-0018 -- Render-only office doctrine: no spatial fact becomes a gameplay input
rulings.summary: The office floor renders state and never produces it -- no spatial fact (grid cell, occupancy, adjacency) may become a gameplay input, so the sim stays headless-testable and the view stays free to change.
rulings.status: DRAFT (formal confirm at 2026-07-27 R3a block; review-by 2027-07-27)
